blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator Loren Legarda sought to recognize and provide financial assistance to single family breadwinners and students who work to support their families. Senate Bill No. 2616, or the proposed “Single Breadwinners Act,” filed by Legarda on Nov. 12, seeks to provide qualified breadwinners access to financial assistance, educational support, psychosocial services, and economic empowerment programs through existing government mechanisms. Qualified as a single family breadwinner are those who provide at least 50 percent of the essential living needs of their dependents.
